_comment: Exact minimum and maximum edge counts of (4,5,m)-graphs (no K_4, no independent 5-set), recomputed from McKay's primary catalogues by r45bounds.py.  Every graph at these extreme edge counts was decoded with this directory's own graph6 decoder and re-checked to be a genuine (4,5)-graph; the decoded edge count was cross-checked against the edge count in McKay's file name.  Completeness of the catalogues is CITED (McKay-Radziszowski 1995), not proved here.

r45extreme.tar.gz.covers: m = 4..23, complete sets at the smallest and largest edge counts
